name: mcdu_rx
note: ARINC 739 — labels received by an LRU from an MCDU. The MCDU transmits ALL its messages to this LRU using the LRU's SAL as the ARINC label number; the message type (ENQ, CTS, KEYBOARD, ACK, SYN, NAK, ...) is encoded in the upper bits of the data field. The logic script decodes message type from .packet directly.

lru_sal_277.description: ARINC 739 SAL for the Hello root-menu LRU. MCDU sends all messages (ENQ/CTS/KBD/ACK/SYN/NAK) on this label number; sub-type is in bits 24-30 of the data field.

lru_sal_306.description: ARINC 739 SAL for the Status root-menu LRU. MCDU sends all messages (ENQ/CTS/KBD/ACK/SYN/NAK) on this label number; sub-type is in bits 24-30 of the data field.

discrete_270.description: MCDU NORMAL DISCRETE WORD (270) — health and status bits broadcast by the MCDU.
